newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen weak on rupiah woes, rates.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen weak on rupiah woes, rates.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen continuing to be weak on Monday because of currency woes and the prospect of high interest rates contiuing for some time, brokers said.
Brokers said trading was likely to be slow in the day because of a holiday in Hong Kong but added that the index was likely headed below 600 points.
The index fell 25.31 points, or 3.94 percent, to close at a year-low of 617.71 points on Friday.
A steep fall on Wall Street on Friday and the prospects of a prolonged drought were also bearish factors, brokers said.
The composite index has lost more than 100 points since the beginning of the month on the weak rupiah and the high short-term rates imposed to curb speculation in the currency.
The rupiah fell to a historic low of 2,960 against the dollar on Friday before a slight recovery. It was trading at 2,925/2,945 at 0220 GMT on Monday.
